_comment: ARV-115: the output hash of the overflow scenario case (OverflowReplayTests): seed 9303's reference evening with the arrivals Visitors snake holding 60 people (ScenarioConfig.OverflowEvening; scripted events unchanged), A-VIS played by S-15, S-17 and the A-OV band's lead S-25, 17:00 to 20:30. 1,693 outputs by type: 567 minute, 224 bin, 224 health (bin health), 211 live, 253 line, 1 outage, 209 overflow (band minutes) and 4 overflow-change (band changes: occupied 18:03, emptied 18:32, occupied 19:33, emptied 19:53). Update only after reviewing the change in the engine's outputs, with the human's approval. Approved by the owner (Ahmad Al-Sadder) on 2026-10-06. ARV-139b (2026-10-07): the F5 re-anchor now waits until every reading of an instant is applied, so a band's 0 read beside the queue zone's previous 0 (S-25's batch ordered before S-15's at 17:59 and 19:28, the first minutes of each wave) no longer drops the people the zone already holds and turns their exits into duplicates: those exits now count, as waits and towards the throughput (minutes 17:58, 17:59 and 19:27 to 19:29, the bins and bin health of 17:45 and 19:15, and 11 live minutes at 17:59 to 18:03 and 19:28 to 19:33 in throughput and nowcast change; queue lengths, every overflow row and change, the line minutes and the outage are byte-identical). The one added output is a minute row, a further provisional revision of minute 19:27 (18 entries, 8 exits, 18 waits): the 10 people who entered 19:27:27 to 19:27:58, dropped at 19:28:00 before, now exit 19:28:01 to 19:29:06, five before the step to 19:28:30 (batches received 19:29) and five after it (batches received 19:30), so minute 19:27's waits go from 8 to 13 and then 18 in two steps, one provisional row each, where they stayed at 8 before (at 17:59 the 2 people held exit within the step that already revised minute 17:58, so no row is added there). Every other type keeps its count. Previous approved head d971a3170539758f5248bfcc01e181e3bfd9ab1aa51dfba638d8908be9948b9a over 1692 outputs (566 minute rows). Approved by the owner (Ahmad Al-Sadder) on 2026-10-07 (ARV-139b re-approval).
